short: M06 ahead for heard speech: a pretrained autoencoder code of vocoder parameters beats spectrograms in all five patients; synthesizer decoding dates to 2009; M12 listener test unrepeated.
position: The paper [@akbari2019] changes the decoding target (M06), adds listener scoring (M12) and uses low-frequency plus high-gamma input (M05). M06 is ahead for heard speech: none of the 5 earlier heard-speech intracranial reconstruction studies decodes vocoder parameters or a pretrained compressed code, and the model ordering repeats in five patients. The claim that synthesizer parameters had never been estimated from neural data does not hold [@guenther2009; @chakrabarti2015]. Raw vocoder parameters score below the spectrogram (ESTOI 0.30 against 0.40) and only the autoencoder code reaches 0.47, so the evidence isolates the coding step, not the external corpus. M12 departs from correlation-only practice but stays standard because the listener result is not repeated across patients.
